name: marketon-e2e
description: MarketON e2e 테스트 (Playwright API 모드 주축)

scripts.e2e:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.e2e.yml up -d --wait && node scripts/wait-for-env.mjs
scripts.e2e:up:ui: docker compose -f docker-compose.e2e.yml --profile ui up -d --wait && node scripts/wait-for-env.mjs --ui
scripts.e2e:reset: npm run e2e:down && npm run e2e:up
